tool_input.code:
const cmd = `
Write-Output '--- where dsh ---'
try { (Get-Command dsh -All | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Source) -join "\`n" } catch { 'ERR ' + $_.Exception.Message }
Write-Output '--- app.asar header (first package.json name/version) ---'
$path = 'D:\\Users\\jjq21\\AppData\\Local\\Programs\\DeepSeek Harness\\resources\\app.asar'
$fs = [System.IO.File]::OpenRead($path)
$br = New-Object System.IO.BinaryReader($fs)
$sz = $br.ReadUInt32(); $hs = $br.ReadUInt32()
Write-Output ("headerSize=$hs")
$bytes = $br.ReadBytes([int]$hs)
$json = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($bytes)
$fs.Close()
Write-Output $json.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(400,$json.Length))
Write-Output '--- try package.json entry ---'
$m = [regex]::Match($json, '"package.json":\\{"size":(\\d+)')
Write-Output $m.Value
`;
const r = await tools.pwsh({ description: "Resolve dsh CLI path and asar header", command: cmd, timeoutMs: 60000 });
if (r.kind === "foreground") console.log(r.stdout.text.slice(0, 3000), "|ERR|", r.stderr.text.slice(0, 500));
tool_input.description: Find dsh CLI path and app version
